command:
for project in rva_gis_station rva_gis_native; do
  cp godot/station_trial/tools/{assemble_gis_pilot,gis_pilot_builder,gis_station_decks,verify_gis_pilot}.gd "outputs/$project/tools/"
done
godot --headless --path outputs/rva_gis_station --check-only --script res://tools/assemble_gis_pilot.gd
godot --headless --path outputs/rva_gis_station --script res://tools/verify_gis_pilot.gd
python3 outputs/rva_gis_station/render_viaducts.py
magick outputs/rva_gis_station/RVA_GIS_Viaducts0.png -quality 84 reports/RVA_GIS_Viaducts.webp
